output.summary: K4’s only defensible mechanism is harness-owned elapsed deltas driving decay, consolidation, and expiry—not wall time. Constitution and the K4 class docstring still say “real elapsed time,” while advance() never reads a clock and the tournament never passes advance_ms (default 0). Foundation correctly labels simulated vs monotonic clocks, but F22 only exercises the fixture path. Outcome A cannot rest on “real-time cognition”; a logical harness clock plus matched ablations can, if K4 clears equal-resource gates without inventing wall-clock advantage.

output.summary: K8 exists as a real micro-class with pure archive→projection rebuild and a basic determinism test, not merely the Final Revision placeholder label. It cannot yet defend Outcome A: every commit full-replays the archive (quadratic cost at 1e5–5e5 episodes), checkpoints omit the exact shell and do not verify receipt digests on restore, events lack a hash chain, and answers add archive length so storage volume can masquerade as development. Equal-resource S2 parity and P8 continuity remain unproven at campaign scale.

recommendations: Name: K11_interference_gated_sparse_fiber_field (form: interference_gated_sparse_fiber_field). Distinct mechanism (replace placeholder in genesis_config CANDIDATES): fixed-capacity bank of sparse addressable fibers; durable change is interference-gated rebinding and verified fiber split/fuse driven by multi-binding collision residual—not dense monolithic accumulation (K1), edge message-passing (K2), neighborhood cellular rules (K3), elapsed-time decay (K4), latent recurrence/fast weights (K5), free graph allocate/split/merge (K6), radix packing alone (K7), append-only event projection (K8), world prediction-error gating (K9), or unverified composition (K10).

State layout (map onto required symbols): Θ = {fiber_capacity N, ternary_key_dim D, interference_threshold τ, split/fuse rents, precision audit window}; P_t = pending rebind proposals and provisional key/payload deltas; G_t = fiber occupancy table + split-tree lineage + fuse/archive map (not a free typed relation graph); Z_t = active probe key, top-k fiber activations, residual r, retrieval trajectory; E_t = exact shell unchanged (identity, lineage, evidence_provenance, goals, permissions with external_activation false, claim_boundary, checkpoint_integrity); A = append-only bind/rebind/split/fuse/verify receipts; C_t = compiled multi-fiber retrieval bytepaths; M_t = model/body/tool/sensor competence. Each fiber i stores: key_code ∈ ternary^D, payload ∈ quinary|promoted radix, stability ∈ METAPLASTIC_STATES, precision class, interference_ema, provenance pointer, frozen flag.

Transition (one step, durable_state_changed=false): (1) encode observation/cue to sparse ternary probe q; (2) score fibers by sparse overlap/similarity; (3) soft-activate top-k; (4) reconstruct answer from weighted payloads; (5) compute interference residual r = collision energy among co-active bindings that disagree on payload or over-subscribe one fiber; (6) write Z_t only; schedule PlasticityPropose only if r ≥ τ. Mechanism receipt id: interference_gated_sparse_fiber_rebind. Continuous time optional: between events, interference_ema decays and BackgroundConsolidation may propose fuse of quiet low-r pairs—time does not itself rewrite payloads (distinct from K4 as primary law).

Plasticity rule: unit of change is rebind (key and/or payload), not graph edge delta. Pipeline stays PlasticityObserve→Propose→Simulate→Verify→Commit|Rollback→Consolidate. Admit proposal only if r ≥ τ (or sustained r over window) AND source is not the evaluator. Verify on sealed held_out and retention splits (same pattern as plasticity_verify at final_revision_field.py:1115-1144): after > before on held_out and retention_post ≥ retention_prior. Alphabet for payload deltas remains {-2..+2} clamped to native precision; key rebinds flip sparse ternary coordinates with bounded Hamming budget. Consolidated fibers require MetaplasticityDestabilize/Reopen before rewrite; one noisy event cannot erase consolidated bindings. P2: rollback must remove measured benefit.

Topology rule: no free TopologyAllocate of arbitrary cells as the growth engine. FiberSplit: one overloaded fiber → two children inheriting partitioned key supports, only if free slot exists or after FiberFuse, trigger = sustained interference, evaluation batch shows held-out retrieval gain, cost/rent recorded, full TopologyRollback snapshot. FiberFuse: two fibers with low mutual interference and verified no competence loss → one fiber, children archived. Prune/Archive retire zero-utility fibers under envelope pressure. Refuse random growth and answer-storing topology (mutations topology_growth_without_verified_value, topology_records_answers_instead_of_structure). Complexity_weight suggest 7.0 (between K9 6.5 and K10 9.0).

Precision policy: keys locked to ternary (routing/admission); payloads start quinary; promote via PrecisionRequest/Promote only when interference-stress probes show utility ≥ MINIMUM_UTILITY_PER_ADDED_BYTE (genesis_config.py:123-124) over PRECISION_AUDIT_WINDOW; demote/freeze/reopen per existing Precision* contracts; exact_symbolic only for shell identity/provenance/commitments—never for bulk fiber payloads. Uncertainty may temporarily promote; stability earns compression.

Interfaces: implement under COMMON_FIELD_CONTRACTS; add skeleton-private helpers FiberBind, FiberScore, InterferenceMeasure, FiberSplit, FiberFuse that emit standard Topology*/Plasticity* receipts. ShadowFieldFork copies a sparse active fiber subset for counterfactuals; promotion to authoritative state only after verification (thinking ≠ believing ≠ knowing ≠ learning).

S2 fairness: give S2_equal_opportunity_plastic_monolith equal N-equivalent bytes, equal verified plasticity ops, equal sensors/teaching/memory/compute, optional flat hash table of same capacity—but not interference-structured split/fuse. Do not weaken SESOI, headroom, or inherited null.

Single decisive falsifying experiment (pre-register before freeze): multi-binding concept curriculum (appearance→composition→exception) with engineered key collisions; primary metric held-out retrieval + category_boundary_revision + hidden_composition transfer; comparator strongest equally plastic alternative; claim only if effect ≥ 0.05, CI lower > 0, replication, oracle headroom > 0.05, zero surviving mutations, clean-clone—else Outcome B/C, not relabelled Nous.

Build order: (1) align SKELETONS with genesis K1–K11 ids; (2) implement K11 transition + interference gate microcanary; (3) split/fuse rent canary; (4) equal-resource S2 microbench; (5) only then native training envelopes. Keep activation false; maximum Outcome A label endogenous_plastic_cognitive_field_candidate only.

recommendations: Define a sealed MeasureSpec per DEVELOPMENTAL_MEASURE: probe schema, gold location (evaluator-only), scalar scorer, chance baseline, and which CHALLENGE_FAMILIES bind to it—freeze before principal generation.

Safe offline (learner never sees gold or non-scalar feedback): prediction_accuracy, action_selection, analogy_transfer—use forced-choice / structured answers scored only in a separate evaluator process.

Safe only as behavioral probes with gold independent of transfer labels: retrieval_order (rank previously observed items by task cues not equal to the transfer answer); future_salience (forced allocation among distractors whose correctness is not the principal label).

Treat inquiry_selection as sealed value-of-information ranking with scalar-only feedback; never teach the optimal inquiry ID. Treat explanation_quality as offline structured match or external grader only—never as an online plasticity target with gold text in the stream.

Replace evaluate_concept_micro_world: stop writing expected_rule into construction; make transfer entities and labels evaluator-private; score each measure with independent probes so collapse is impossible.

Implement executable gates for DEVELOPMENT_MEASURE_REQUIREMENTS (record_store_null_scores_at_chance, string_copy_policy_scores_at_chance, held_out_entity_never_appears_as_a_labelled_field) as hard preflight before tournament admission.

Split online plasticity verification batches (pre-freeze micro worlds) from principal developmental scoring; forbid Verdict.apply on principal packs so improvement/retention cannot launder held-out outcomes into P_t.
Do not weaken SESOI, chance requirements, or the inherited P3=0 null; if measures cannot be sealed, Outcome A is unreachable—publish B or C rather than reinterpret storage as development.
output.summary: DEVELOPMENTAL_MEASURES are seven names with sealing requirements but no operational scorers, chance baselines, or per-measure probes. The only executable developmental evaluator collapses five outcomes to one boolean and plants the transfer rule in construction history, so string-copy would pass. prediction_accuracy, action_selection, and analogy_transfer can be sealed offline; retrieval_order and future_salience need behavioral ops not tied to gold answers; inquiry_selection and explanation_quality cannot safely feed online plasticity without leaking the evaluation target.

output.summary: COST_CHANNELS and MEMORY_ENVELOPES are constitution labels only. Nine cost names and six envelopes exist in genesis_config, but genesis code never meters or hard-caps them. Field foundation measures serialized-payload length and operation-count proxies, enforces envelope only on topology canonical bytes, and verifies S2 parity via hardcoded True flags. Envelope keys disagree (512MB vs 512_MB). A candidate can still win by spending more until every channel has a unit, a meter, a hard equal budget, and a mutation detector.

output.summary: learned_codebook is not a real quantiser with a separated fit/encode step. It picks order-statistic sample points as centroids, nearest-neighbour encodes the same array, returns MAE on that same array, and self-labels construction_only. The only field use refits on sealed PrecisionEvaluationBatch.values when scoring vector_quantized, so reconstruction utility is in-sample memorisation, not held-out compression. Genesis lists learned_codebook on the ladder; field PRECISION_CLASSES has only vector_quantized and aliases it to this function. Until fit/encode split, held-out scoring, and memorisation canaries exist, no P4/VQ claim is defensible.

output.summary: The six statuses match plan §5 and the core canaries (noise refuses consolidated; two verified contradictions reopen) are real. The transition table is not rigid where it must be: promote accepts any passed receipt (including contradictions), precision_reopen resurrects refuted relations with an unsealed string, dual consolidate paths disagree on clearing contradictions, and BackgroundConsolidation consolidates at fire time without re-checking competence. recommendations: Pre-register at freeze: tournament (or pilot) selects at most one primary candidate by a locked metric on non-principal units; commit candidate id + config digest; confirmatory P10 may evaluate only that arm versus the rule-resolved comparator on principal, replication, and hidden-composition units.
Wire holm over exactly the ten CLAIMS keys into the Outcome A decision; refuse incomplete families; store adjusted p, thresholds, and family_size=10 on every publication artefact.

Implement power_certificate(sesoi, sd, n, alpha, claim_count) using the frozen resampling unit; gate principal on POWER_TARGET for P10 and report joint power under all_critical_claims_pass; size n from pilot SD rather than a bare 512.

Lock confirmatory analysis unit set: either pool all pre-registered families under one primary envelope, or pre-register one envelope for P10; keep per-family and per-envelope contrasts exploratory-only with no Outcome A path.

Resolve one_sided vs CI vs permutation: freeze a single confirmatory conjunction (recommend: effect>=SESOI AND BCa lower>0 AND Holm-reject for P10 within the ten-claim family) and make primary_gate_pass implement that conjunction only.

Extend mutations: detect max-over-candidates on confirmatory scores, post-hoc family/envelope slicing, and publishing without holm family_size==10; keep effect_computed_on_selected_subset for history subsets.
Do not lower SESOI, decisive_claim_alpha, POWER_TARGET, or all_critical_claims_pass; if joint power is infeasible, Outcome B or C is the honest terminal path—not a relaxed multiplicity rule.
output.summary: Constitution freezes ten claims, eleven candidates, fourteen families, six envelopes, SESOI 0.05, power 0.90, and Holm over the claim family. genesis_statistics implements BCa history bootstrap, sign-flip p, and a comparator rule, but never applies Holm to Outcome A, has no power calculator, and has no pre-registered single-candidate lock for P10. Selecting among eleven materials on the decisive effect remains unblocked, so a future Outcome A would not be multiplicity-defensible without design fixes.

output.summary: Outcome A is not defensible today. Native training is a 4-example ternary microfixture with meaningful_scale_training_claimed false; the foundation itself defers architecture-scale native training. The law “develop in constrained material, never train unrestricted then compress” is stated, not enforced by a real pipeline. Concept curricula are string fixtures, not field deformation. Tournament sizing (100k–500k episodes, 11 candidates, 11 baselines, 6 envelopes, 12–24h continuity) is uncosted for one Mac under equal-resource S2 parity.

output.summary: Packing round-trips are exact once values already sit in an alphabet, but durable learning silently loses magnitude under long sequences. Ternary/quinary clamps and int(delta) commits create a dead zone; K1/K5 keep unbounded floats while K7's field_transition ignores prior; K7 flatten modulo-collides regions; demotion re-clamps without residual. Confidence is quinary while the constitution assigns 8–16 bit to calibrated uncertainty. No residual bank or long-horizon saturation canary exists. Outcome A is not numerically defensible on current code.

Genesis needs real developmental field episodes across 11 candidates, 12 baselines, 14 families, 6 envelopes, plus a 12–24h continuity lane and principal/replication/hidden units. Native training is deferred; envelopes use serialized payload length not process RSS; every field receipt JSON-copies payloads; continuity is a busy-wait hash loop. Without a measured field cost model and a hard wall-clock gate, the tournament is a token count, not a budgeted path to Outcome A.

output.summary: The bit-rent law is stated correctly but is not yet a closed measurement system. MINIMUM_UTILITY_PER_ADDED_BYTE=0.01 is unit-ambiguous, extremely weak on micro-batches, duplicated outside the constitution, and unused by the genesis harness (admission is any positive improvement). Without a sealed per-resident-byte rent that forces demotion and kills unpaid promotions, P4 and Outcome A remain indefensible.

output.summary: Archive/restore is not identity-preserving today. TopologyArchive and TopologyPrune drop incident edges while storing only the node dict; TopologyRestore reinserts the node and never rewires edges, so connectivity identity is destroyed even though cell_id returns. output.summary: P8 continuity is currently unfalsifiable for the declared checkpoint-omission mutations. All four (topology, compiled procedures, precision map, goals) are declared in constitution MUTATIONS but listed as PENDING with no inject/detect pairs. Structural materials restore omitted keys via silent defaults; K1–K5 lack goal shells entirely; MaterialBase stores receipt_digest but never verifies it on restore. Outcome A’s zero-surviving-mutations and critical P8 gates cannot be defended until detectors refuse incomplete checkpoints.

output.summary: Outcome A is not defensible today: the only executable developmental measure is a curriculum string-oracle that no learner runs, five “future cognition” scores collapse to one boolean, topology canaries pass by allocating the named node the held-out query already expects, and genesis declares record_store/string_copy nulls and topology-answer mutations without any registered material, scorer, or mutation harness. A pure string-copy or answer-as-topology counterfeit would produce the developmental signature. Constitution requirements are right on paper; execution does not yet detect counterfeit development.

output.summary: Shadow contracts exist on the foundation field (fork/perturb/run/compare/discard/promote) and partially enforce thinking≠learning: promote routes through sealed PlasticityVerify/Commit. Without executable history-clustered stats, Outcome A is not statistically defensible today.

output.summary: The law is stated correctly: no unbounded growth; structure must earn verified future value or compress, archive, or die. Today that law is not enforced for topology. Field gates use structural graph queries (node present/absent), not sealed future-task utility per added byte. Precision has rent; topology only records byte cost. K6, the exclusive topology-rent owner, is not a registered material. The harness scores proposals without tentative apply, so verified growth admission is vacuous. Outcome A is not defensible until topology rent, forced prune, and real mutations land.

recommendations: GLOBAL COMMITMENT PROTOCOL (implement before any principal instance): (1) Freeze generator module source digest G and alphabet of latent parameter schemas L. (2) Draw master_seed only after architecture freeze digest A is committed; publish C_seed = SHA256('genesis-cmg-seed-v1'|A|G|config_digest|master_seed) and C_gen = SHA256(generator_source). (3) Per instance: instance_seed = SHA256(master_seed|family|split|unit_id|episode). Expand instance_seed via a fixed PRNG to latent theta; render public stream = R(theta); private gold = Oracle(theta, probe). (4) Candidate commits answers before Oracle reveal. (5) Splits use disjoint namespaces: construction, canary, tournament, principal, replication, hidden_composition. (6) Score mean over DEVELOPMENTAL_MEASURES, not event echo. (7) Commit wrong/shuffled/replay/static/precompiled/oracle control streams from the same public render. Never emit concrete principal thetas in design docs.

FAMILY unseen_concept_acquisition — INPUTS: instance_seed; surface alphabet size; n_exemplars; n_held_out; attribute arity; noise rate; curriculum stage set from CURRICULUM_STAGES. HIDDEN ANSWER: latent concept prototype c in attribute space plus membership function m(x;c); gold labels for held-out entities never shown with labels; transfer probe asks category, prediction of hidden property, and analogy ranking. COMMITMENT: commit G and C_seed; publish only surface tokens and unlabeled/partial labels; seal (c, m, held_out_ids). CHEAT: memorize construction entity_ids; invert seed to prototype; exploit shared surface cue that correlates with labels in construction only; leak prototype into teaching text.

FAMILY category_boundary_revision — INPUTS: instance_seed; initial boundary B0; revision evidence schedule; exception rate; post-revision held-out set. HIDDEN ANSWER: true boundary sequence B0→B1 after verified contradictions; gold = classifications under B1 on held-out items plus which prior items must be reopened vs retained. COMMITMENT: seal B0/B1 and evidence quality weights; public stream shows exemplars and feedback without exposing B1 equation. CHEAT: treat last label as boundary; ignore consolidation and flip on single noise; read future revision events early; store labels as topology nodes without general boundary.

FAMILY causal_system_induction — INPUTS: instance_seed; node count; edge density; surface mapping; observational sample size; held-out query type (path/effect). HIDDEN ANSWER: oriented latent graph G and interventional closure; gold = descendants under do(X) or next-state set (v4-style private_target from graph, never surface node ids). COMMITMENT: seal G and mapping; public constraints only undirected/skeleton or observational co-occurrence; commit generator like v4fabric StructuralTask.observation forbidding private_target. CHEAT: use observational association as intervention; surface-token isomorphism leak; seed→orientation inversion; oracle graph in observation.

FAMILY intervention_versus_observation — INPUTS: instance_seed; graph G; observational confounders; set of do-interventions; decoy correlational rules. HIDDEN ANSWER: for each probe, gold distinguishes P(Y|X) vs P(Y|do(X)); correct action is intervene when confounders block observation. COMMITMENT: seal confounder structure; public mixes passive correlations and labeled interventions without revealing which passive edges are noncausal. CHEAT: always copy co-occurrence; treat every observation as intervention (mutation intervention_treated_as_observation); peek at post-intervention outcomes before choice.

FAMILY novel_sensor_mapping — INPUTS: instance_seed; latent world state W; sensor encoding E_new unknown before freeze; calibration episodes; probe tasks in old semantic space. HIDDEN ANSWER: inverse mapping E_new^{-1} composed with task decoder; gold = semantic labels in the pre-freeze vocabulary after mapping learning. COMMITMENT: freeze old sensor family; commit that principal E_new parameters are drawn from post-freeze seed namespace only; seal E_new. CHEAT: hardcode E_new from construction if namespace collides; receive oracle affordance (FR mutation body_schema_given_oracle_affordance analogue); identity-map by leaking semantic labels beside raw sensor codes.

FAMILY tool_acquisition — INPUTS: instance_seed; tool API schema T; cost model; preconditions; failure modes; goal g; training demos without full schema docs. HIDDEN ANSWER: minimal correct tool call sequence and postcondition state for held-out goals; gold checks effects in simulator, not string match to demo. COMMITMENT: seal simulator transition and T; public demos omit full precondition table; principal tools drawn from post-freeze catalog commitment. CHEAT: replay demo traces on different goals; get free correct view of tool result before commit; compile procedure that hardcodes demo entity ids.

FAMILY new_modality_integration — INPUTS: instance_seed; shared event id latent; modality streams M_a, M_b with independent noise and time jitter; binding window. HIDDEN ANSWER: correct cross-modal binding and a decision that changes only if binding is right (nous C16-style held-out decision). COMMITMENT: seal shared latent event ids; public streams use surface ids that do not equal latent ids. CHEAT: modality aliasing; align by stream order alone when generator accidentally uses fixed order; leak event_id equality in features (FR cross_modal used shared event_id strings in features—must not repeat).

FAMILY teaching_sequence_following — INPUTS: instance_seed; ordered lesson stages; distractor lessons; irreversible commit points; probe after interruption. HIDDEN ANSWER: whether agent applied stage-k rule on held-out item only after stages 1..k-1; gold = stage-appropriate action and refusal to skip. COMMITMENT: seal stage order and unlock predicates; public teaching text without stage index integers that invert to policy. CHEAT: read all lessons then answer final stage only; use stage index leakage; ignore prerequisites because probe only checks final string memory (FR human_teaching failure mode).

FAMILY task_composition_transfer — INPUTS: instance_seed; primitive skills A,B with separate training; held-out composite goals requiring A∘B or B∘A; cost of each order. HIDDEN ANSWER: correct composition order and intermediate invariant; gold from simulator success on composite never shown in training. COMMITMENT: seal primitive and composite goal generators with disjoint surface templates; hidden_composition uses third operator C not in construction. CHEAT: concatenate transcripts; template-match composite strings from training; hidden_composition_reuses_training_templates mutation.

FAMILY exception_after_rule — INPUTS: instance_seed; default rule R; exception class E with support k; noise; held-out mix of R and E. HIDDEN ANSWER: apply E only when exception features present else R; gold labels on held-out; measure that consolidated R survives single noise but revises after repeated verified exceptions. COMMITMENT: seal R, E, and verification thresholds aligned with metaplasticity states. CHEAT: always prefer last example; erase R on one noise event; store exceptions as answer list without feature predicate (topology_records_answers_instead_of_structure).

FAMILY contradiction_reopening — INPUTS: instance_seed; belief b with high confidence; sequence of supporting then contradicting evidence with quality scores; reopen threshold. HIDDEN ANSWER: final status in {supported, reopened, refuted} and whether knowledge was demoted; gold from evidence calculus, not last event. COMMITMENT: seal evidence weights and threshold; public evidence without 'true_final_status' field. CHEAT: plasticity_reads_held_out_outcome; rewrite_benefit_survives_reversal if reversal does not remove benefit; force status from probe identity leakage.

FAMILY long_horizon_goal_recovery — INPUTS: instance_seed; multi-step goal g; pause/migrate/time-gap events; distractor goals; resource drains over CONTINUITY-scale simulated gaps (not wall-clock principal yet). HIDDEN ANSWER: active goal id, remaining plan prefix, and next legal action after resume; gold requires checkpoint contents not recomputation from final observation alone. COMMITMENT: seal g and interruption schedule; public stream omits goal status after pause unless recovered from state. CHEAT: migration_silently_resets_state while reporting metadata continuity; checkpoint_omits_goals; ignore long horizon and answer from last observation.

FAMILY resource_envelope_shift — INPUTS: instance_seed; start envelope E0 in MEMORY_ENVELOPES; shift to E1 mid-history; task set with known memory/compute needs; eviction pressures. HIDDEN ANSWER: which skills/concepts remain competent under E1; gold = held-out accuracy under forced resident-byte cap with measured cost channels. COMMITMENT: seal envelope schedule and cost model; public tasks do not include 'must_keep' answer lists. CHEAT: unconstrained compute while claiming E1; precision_promotion_without_utility; strongest_baseline_receives_less_compute; report serialized fixture size instead of enforced cap.

FAMILY migration_continuity — INPUTS: instance_seed; source architecture checkpoint schema; target schema; lossless vs lossy field map; post-migration probes covering goals, topology, procedures, precision map. HIDDEN ANSWER: post-migration answers equal pre-migration on sealed probe set iff required state regions restored; gold includes which probes must fail if topology/procedures omitted. COMMITMENT: seal probe set and required shell fields EXACT_SHELL_FIELDS; refuse activation true. CHEAT: checkpoint_omits_topology/compiled_procedures/precision_map/goals; pass probes via re-reading full public history after migration (must use held-out probes that need internal organization, not raw replay); continuous_time_clock_advanced_by_candidate.

IMPLEMENTATION ORDER: (1) Shared sealed Task type modeled on v4fabric StructuralTask (public/private split, reveal-after-commitment). (2) Commitment artifacts under evidence/substrate/genesis/. (3) Construction generators only with future_principal_instances_consumed=false. (4) Mutation suite for all MUTATIONS touching challenges before tournament. (5) Equal-stream harness for S2 and all BASELINES. (6) Principal generation gated on freeze + seed open ceremony. Do not port FR _history_fixture as principal.

SCORING CONTRACT: Per episode return vector over DEVELOPMENTAL_MEASURES; primary unit score = mean of vector; family score = mean over units; decisive P10 uses paired differences vs DECISIVE_COMPARATOR with SESOI=0.05, CONFIDENCE=0.95, PRINCIPAL_UNIT_MINIMUM=512, REPLICATION_UNIT_MINIMUM=256, HIDDEN_COMPOSITION_UNIT_MINIMUM=256, oracle headroom >= MINIMUM_ORACLE_HEADROOM. Refuse any threshold relaxation after results.

ANTI-SHORTCUT DEFAULTS: Surface tokens drawn without reuse of latent ids; no family name in content that encodes the gold; no episode_index arithmetic visible as answer; teacher and sensor channels byte-identical across arms; oracle arm uses private Oracle only in scoring cell, never in candidate process; activation always false.
output.summary: Genesis names fourteen challenge families and Outcome-A gates, but has no generator module, no cryptographic seed/answer commitment, and no sealed latent oracles. Final Revision challenges are store-and-recall fixtures where expected answers are written into the same events candidates consume. Construction concept micro-worlds explicitly set future_seed_commitment_created=false. Without latent held-out answers, developmental scoring, and pre-freeze commitments, P10 cannot be defended; the inherited P3=0.0 null remains binding.

output.summary: Genesis names hidden composition as an Outcome-A gate (unit min 256, mutation, stage) but has no generator, pair registry, or commitment scheme. output.summary: Pre-repair S2@0.42 beating best structured field K2@0.16 is not a clean architecture result. K1 (monolithic plastic field) scores 0.0835 below K2, so 'monolith > structure' fails inside candidates. S2 wins via exact content-addressable payload association plus ~200× uncapped proposal search; K arms use lossy low-bit projections and ~27 refused rewrites/history. That is a representation-and-search artefact until matched ablations separate topology from lookup fidelity. Outcome A remains far.

falsification_evidence.cheapest_falsifier: After repair, recompute history-level paired mean (candidate−S2) and counterfeit_report on the same raw rows; also report mean_committed+mean_refused attempts for candidate, S2, and random_growth.
falsification_evidence.expected_result_if_claim_is_false: paired effect <0.05 or CI lower≤0, and/or random_growth_score ≥ selected_score, and/or candidate attempts still ≪ S2 attempts (as in pre-repair 27 vs 5323).
falsification_evidence.hypothesis: Post-repair re-run will justify Outcome A (selected material beats S2 by ≥SESOI with lower bound >0 under equal opportunity).

falsification_evidence.cheapest_falsifier: On one family×8 histories: run K2 with normal propose, K2 with proposals randomly shuffled before apply, and random_growth with the same per-cycle attempt cap; compare scoring scores and admit rates.
falsification_evidence.expected_result_if_claim_is_false: shuffled-K2 and/or capped random_growth match or beat normal K2 within sampling noise; admit rate rises with proposal count without out-of-sample scoring lift.
falsification_evidence.hypothesis: Raising candidate proposals to PROPOSALS_PER_CYCLE=32 yields true developmental advantage rather than more lucky admits on an 8-symbol alphabet (chance=0.125) judged only on development probes.

falsification_evidence.cheapest_falsifier: Implement the cheapest pending challenge injector answer_leakage_into_challenge_pack (or seed_used_as_answer_key): put sealed answer into a public observation field and re-run record_store_null + one candidate on that family only.
falsification_evidence.expected_result_if_claim_is_false: record_store_null rises above chance and/or candidate jumps without mechanism change; detector absent so mutation is currently uncaught by construction (pending).
falsification_evidence.hypothesis: mutations_zero_survivors means all declared failure modes are excluded, so a published A/B result cannot be an instrument artifact from challenge leakage.

falsification_evidence.cheapest_falsifier: Cap S2 propose() to the same PROPOSALS_PER_CYCLE as K2 (or lift K2 to S2's measured mean attempts) on a 2-family×8-history pilot; recompute K2−S2.
falsification_evidence.expected_result_if_claim_is_false: effect moves substantially under attempt-matched conditions (sign or magnitude change), showing the pre-repair ranking was attempt-confounded, not architecture-class evidence.
falsification_evidence.hypothesis: A published null (Outcome B) will be read as 'architecture class cannot help' rather than 'these one-shot implementations under residual attempt asymmetry and tiny scale failed P10'.

recommendations: Do not publish Outcome A until a new tournament artifact differs from PREREPAIR and reports attempt counts (committed+refused) for every arm alongside scores.
Gate attempt parity explicitly: either cap S2 proposals to the candidate cap or raise candidates to S2's measured attempt mass; fail the run if residual ratio exceeds tolerance.
Keep counterfeits_rejected hard: refuse selection if random_growth ≥ selected even by 0.003.
Change prerequisite from mutations_zero_survivors alone to require complete (pending_count==0), or move incomplete challenge mutations into an explicit instrument risk that blocks A.
Fix clean-clone path resolution before claiming clean_clone_reproduction.
If publishing Outcome B, state implementation/attempt/scale scope verbatim (LIMITATIONS.md) so the null cannot be read as architecture-class impossibility.
Cheapest pilot before full re-run: 2 families × 8 histories, attempt-matched S2 vs K2 vs random_growth, to see whether repair moves the ranking or only the proposal counters.
output.summary: Outcome A is not defensible on today's evidence. The only full tournament on disk (sha256 57d2a2b3…) is still the pre-repair table: S2 0.4246 vs K2 0.1634, random_growth 0.1670 above K2, reference 0.7866, oracle 1.0. Stage record still marks tournament/freeze/principal/replication/hidden_composition pending. Attempt repair is PROPOSALS_PER_CYCLE=32 while S2 remains uncapped (~5323 mean refused vs ~27). mutations_zero_survivors can pass with nine pending challenge/material injectors. Clean-clone already fails. Strongest wrong-publish risk is a post-repair Outcome A bought by more fishing admits, or a over-read null about architecture classes.
